uq_nf_fornecedor_chave.name: uq_nf_fornecedor_chave
uq_nf_fornecedor_chave.where: "notas_fiscais_fornecedor"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "notas_fiscais_fornecedor"."chave" IS NOT NULL

chk_assoc_hist_um_alvo.name: chk_assoc_hist_um_alvo
chk_assoc_hist_um_alvo.value: ("associacoes_peca_historico"."peca_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("associacoes_peca_historico"."subitem_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

chk_etiq_um_alvo.name: chk_etiq_um_alvo
chk_etiq_um_alvo.value: ("etiquetas_impressoes"."peca_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("etiquetas_impressoes"."subitem_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

uq_carga_itens_peca.name: uq_carga_itens_peca
uq_carga_itens_peca.where: "carga_itens"."peca_id" IS NOT NULL AND "carga_itens"."status_carga_item" <> 'removido' AND "carga_itens"."deleted_at" IS NULL

uq_carga_itens_subitem.name: uq_carga_itens_subitem
uq_carga_itens_subitem.where: "carga_itens"."subitem_id" IS NOT NULL AND "carga_itens"."status_carga_item" <> 'removido' AND "carga_itens"."deleted_at" IS NULL

chk_carga_itens_tipo_origem_xor.name: chk_carga_itens_tipo_origem_xor
chk_carga_itens_tipo_origem_xor.value:
("carga_itens"."tipo_origem" = 'peca'    AND "carga_itens"."peca_id"    IS NOT NULL AND "carga_itens"."subitem_id" IS NULL) OR
          ("carga_itens"."tipo_origem" = 'subitem' AND "carga_itens"."subitem_id" IS NOT NULL AND "carga_itens"."peca_id"    IS NULL)
